# Third-party assets

- `app/src/main/res/font/google_sans_*.ttf`: static Latin subsets of
  [Google Sans](https://github.com/googlefonts/googlesans) (opsz 17 for "text", 18 for the rest;
  weights 400 and 500), licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, see
  `google-sans/OFL.txt`.
- `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_*.xml` (except `ic_live.xml`):
  [Material Symbols](https://github.com/google/material-design-icons) (Outlined), licensed
  under the Apache License 2.0.
